theme: A light Sunday before a travel day.
greeting: A quiet Sunday, Dan — the board reset with Mike this morning and dinner at Misi to close it out. Tomorrow leans busy: neurology at HSS in the early afternoon, then the evening flight back to Florida.

needsAttention.title: Book the last Dubrovnik night
needsAttention.detail: The final charter night, Sat Sept 19 in Cavtat near the airport, ahead of the 7:30 AM Sunday flight out. Flagged p1 on the Mike + Dan board, due today.

needsAttention.title: Neurology, then the flight home
needsAttention.detail: Arrive by 1:45 PM for Dr. Manning at HSS Belaire in Manhattan, then the 6:30 PM flight (DL 2433) out of LaGuardia to Florida. Worth staging bags before you leave.

recipe.title: Poached Peaches
recipe.why: High summer means peaches at their ripest, best gently poached before the season turns.

acts.line: The 9 AM board reset with Mike is the one fixed point before noon.
Open on the calendar, nothing scheduled.
Dinner at Misi at 6:45 closes the day.
